cues.exercise_complete: Exercise complete. How did that feel?
cues.exercise_skipped: Exercise skipped. Get ready for the next movement.
cues.feedback_bad: Got it. We'll keep that in mind.
cues.workout_complete: Today's session is complete. Nice work.
cues.switch_sides: Switch sides and get into position.
cues.bird_dog_prepare: Bird dog. Come onto your hands and knees, find a steady position, and get ready.
cues.bird_dog_left_first: Begin. Reach your left arm forward and your right leg back. Keep your pelvis steady and breathe.
cues.bird_dog_left: Left arm forward, right leg back. Stay steady and breathe.
cues.bird_dog_right: Right arm forward, left leg back. Stay steady and breathe.
cues.static_plank_prepare: Static plank. Find a stable position and get ready.
cues.static_plank_start: Begin the plank. Brace gently, keep your body in one long line, and keep breathing.
cues.static_plank_set_2: Set two. Begin, and keep breathing.
cues.static_plank_set_3: Set three. Begin, and keep breathing.
cues.static_plank_rest_2: Rest. Breathe normally. Set two is next.
cues.static_plank_rest_3: Rest. Breathe normally. Set three is next.
cues.side_plank_prepare: Side plank. Find a stable position and get ready.
cues.side_plank_left: Begin on your left side. Lift your hips, keep your body long, and breathe.
cues.side_plank_right: Begin on your right side. Lift your hips, keep your body long, and breathe.
cues.side_plank_rest_right: Rest and breathe. Your right side is next.
cues.side_plank_rest_left: Rest and breathe. Your left side is next.
cues.cat_cow_prepare: Cat cow. Come onto your hands and knees. Work slowly, and stay within a comfortable range.
cues.cat_cow_start: Begin cat cow. Slowly round your back, then gently release.
cues.cat_cow_rep_2: Rep two. Slowly round, then release.
cues.cat_cow_rep_3: Rep three. Slowly round, then release.
cues.cat_cow_rep_4: Rep four. Slowly round, then release.
cues.cat_cow_rep_5: Rep five. Slowly round, then release.
cues.cat_cow_rep_6: Rep six. Slowly round, then release.
cues.cat_cow_rep_7: Rep seven. Slowly round, then release.
cues.cat_cow_rep_8: Rep eight. Slowly round, then release.
cues.cat_cow_rep_9: Rep nine. Slowly round, then release.
cues.cat_cow_rep_10: Rep ten. Slowly round, then release.
